title: Confinement effects on molecular diffusion in zeolites: mechanisms and perspectives
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,210-253
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00613A, Review Article
Lei Zhao, Jiamin Yuan, Youdong Xing, Ji Qi, Peng Peng, Zhiqiang Liu, Anmin Zheng
